AQ0.question: Is there an anteroposterior (portable) projection in this chest radiograph? Answer yes or no.

AQ1.question: Was this chest radiograph acquired with an anteroposterior (AP) projection? Answer yes or no.

AQ2.question: Does this chest radiograph show an AP (anteroposterior) view rather than a PA (posteroanterior) view? Answer yes or no.

view_AP.selection_reason: AQ2: highest one-sided 95% lower bound of the clean-answer AUROC (0.5010) among the eligible phrasings ['AQ2']
